performance: Corrected runs retain identical derived results. Pool/payment medians differ little; timer-inclusive candidate is 2.46–2.56% slower than v0.24 and 6.38–7.54% slower than the original. This is retained optimization work, not a speedup claim.
limits: Host owns cast admission, pricing, aura authority/installation/teardown, duplicate-lane and unlearning locks, cost wards, regeneration, effect execution, saves and UI.
Borrowed state/read ports are trusted; finite nonnegative cost and dt arguments are validated. Unchecked underfunded pay preserves partial spending and is not atomic.
Crossing the idle deadline uses the whole frame; raw regeneration is sampled before healing/diversion. No new phase or post-healing death check is introduced.
Native engine packages and Steam Deck/older-mobile acceptance remain incomplete. Exact-commit CI is recorded separately after publication.
